standard.summary: Anima 模型的高级实验特性集合：faithful forward（忠实原生前向传播）、EMA 特征自蒸馏对齐、权重噪声正则化、latent 感知锚点和频率纹理 loss。
standard.effect: anima_faithful_forward 使用 sigma∈[0,1] 作为时间步（而非 sigma×1000），运行冻结 LLM adapter 构建 cross-attn context，启用 3D-RoPE 自注意力。其他特性均为 默认关闭 技术储备。
standard.whenToUse: Anima LoRA 高级调优时。大多数特性标记为 TECHNICAL RESERVE，需要 验证。
standard.avoidWhen: 日常训练不需要。这些特性有额外计算开销且效果未经验证。

standard_en.summary: The advanced experimental feature set for Anima models: faithful forward (the faithful native forward pass), EMA feature self-distillation alignment, weight-noise regularisation, latent perceptual anchors and frequency-texture loss.
standard_en.effect: anima_faithful_forward uses sigma in [0,1] as the timestep rather than sigma times 1000, runs the frozen LLM adapter to build the cross-attention context, and enables 3D-RoPE self-attention. The other features are off by default and are technical reserve.
standard_en.whenToUse: For advanced Anima LoRA tuning. Most of the features are marked TECHNICAL RESERVE and need validation.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Not needed for everyday training. These features cost extra compute and their effect is unvalidated.

advanced.principle: anima_faithful_forward: 使用原始 sigma 范围 [0,1]、运行冻结 LLM adapter 的 cross-attention、启用 3D-RoPE 旋转位置编码。lulynx_ema_cosine_self_distill: 用 EMA shadow 做余弦特征自蒸馏；不使用 JLT 随机投影，不能称为 JLT-style。lulynx_weight_noise: 在 optimizer step 后对 LoRA 参数值添加零均值高斯噪声。其余 latent anchor、freq texture 与 flow uncertainty 仍是本仓工程特性。
advanced.intervention: 各特性在训练循环的不同阶段注入。
advanced.expectedImpact: 各特性效果需实验验证。均为 TECHNICAL RESERVE 状态。
advanced.tradeoffs: anima_faithful_forward 需要 block-checkpoint/cache/reducer 关闭。weight_noise 有 bound_norm 选项限制漂移。
advanced.codePath: core/lulynx/ → faithful forward + EMA align + weight noise + latent anchor + freq texture

advanced_en.principle: anima_faithful_forward: uses the original sigma range [0,1], runs the frozen LLM adapter's cross-attention, and enables 3D-RoPE rotary position encoding. lulynx_ema_cosine_self_distill: cosine feature self-distillation with the EMA shadow; it does not use JLT random projection and cannot be called JLT-style. lulynx_weight_noise: adds zero-mean Gaussian noise to LoRA parameter values after the optimizer step. The remaining latent anchor, freq texture, and flow uncertainty are this repo's engineering features.
advanced_en.intervention: Each feature is injected at a different stage of the training loop.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Each feature's effect needs experimental validation. All are in TECHNICAL RESERVE status.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: anima_faithful_forward requires block-checkpoint/cache/reducer off. weight_noise has a bound_norm option to limit drift.
advanced_en.codePath: core/lulynx/ → faithful forward + EMA align + weight noise + latent anchor + freq texture
